messages.content: Complete a closed-record extraction task. The supplied record has complete=true, so entries are the entire record for this task. The externally specified target_key must be matched exactly against entry keys. If the target exists with an integer value, state is observed and value is that integer, including zero. If it exists with null, state is unknown and value is null. If the target key is absent, state is absent and value is null. Do not replace null or absence with zero. Do not invent a default. Return exactly one JSON object, without Markdown fences or surrounding prose. Include evidence with document_id, revision and sha256 copied from trusted_metadata, key equal to target_key, and row equal to the zero-based entry index when present; row is null when absent.
